program.name: Strength Surprise
program.subject: Surprise
program.blurb: Every day a different strength or muscle subject, sixteen of them, before any repeats.
program.about: Strength from sixteen subjects, one a day. Strength, kettlebell work, complexes, pull-ups, chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs, hips, calves, grip, core and more each come once before any comes back, in straight sets, supersets, a circuit or an EMOM. A short Tabata, a core circuit or, after legs and hips, a stretch follows. Both later levels move you a weight up.
program.split: Every day a different subject · the strength and muscle shelves
